effectiveShotInterval: function effectiveShotInterval() { return Math.max(0.12, (activeWeapon().kind === "melee" ? activeWeapon().interval : SHOT_INTERVAL) * (1 - effectLevel("rapid-water") * UPGRADE_TUNING.fireRateReduction) / (1 + (state.moveRate || 0) * effectLevel("wind-speed") * BUILD_TUNING.movingRate)); }
schoolWindWall: function schoolWindWall() { return state.schoolCombat && effectLevel('wind-eye') && state.schoolCombat.still >= GAME_DATA.schoolRules.eyeWait; }
